sources.title: GitHub - CompVis/stable-diffusion: A latent text-to-image diffusion model
sources.snippet: Note: Stable Diffusion v1 is a general text-to-image diffusion model and therefore mirrors biases and (mis-)conceptions that are present in its training data. Details on the training procedure and data, as well as the intended use of the model can be found in the corresponding model card.
